children: By Brian Schwartz and Marianne LeVine
WASHINGTON-President Trump said on Friday he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House over their coverage of his administration.

"Outlets shouldn't be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they're covering the President of the United States, the Trump Administration, or the United States of America," Trump wrote in a Truth Social post.
He said the ban would take effect immediately.
